result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, my recommendation would be **Stripe as your main payment processor, with PayPal as an additional checkout option.**

However, the best choice depends on which platform your store uses, how much you sell and where your customers are based.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Für Hello Kitty Fans - Mibrix](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tOiZ9v22mWkKDkODjZ-v8UmHuYEacS351-fhJlicedtzRtyvIPyT0LbHRVsov1FwCqimbt2M5XbGmMjfcFRqoBnSC867jR1vj2Q9kN8GWqWxrNowdJCqgKFlsNcxOvUQZiEoQ3wUV3e9Iv-ULg-8O_uiwrVTYdmAuanbvrKZ5q48tOAeoqXUh_tpwPm1cZkj?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Competitive UK card processing rates.
- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and other platforms.
- Supports Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscriptions.
  
  Indicative UK domestic card rate: 1.5% + 20p.
  
  [Stripe UK website](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

(Best additional option)

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers.
- Customers can pay using their PayPal balance.
- Easy to add alongside card payments.
- Fees can be relatively high.
  
  [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Great if you sell online and in person.
- Simple setup.
- Online store and payment links available.
- Good small-business tools.
  
  [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Shopify Payments en México 2026: Comisiones y Cuándo Conviene | Atémpora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/uaDWm9NONCBgwuJmZgfert_G31d46hLlI4IfJXvnluf3W2KNJh1m0Hd6lZrNGAPmsyHRrilMlk9B4682s-cn40d1cp-SjQrlAzuD2UEX8iNzkLVIhiPrHZ-Q-BYlhpFfZG8FNzWKzH1o7gk5YwcfdyrA6rRsIlL4g3Z9SJ_DAnqpO6UXb7hjSC1HIAun6cGh?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Shopify Payments**

- Best if your website runs on Shopify.
- Integrated checkout and reporting.
- No need to manage a separate card processor.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees charged by Shopify.
  
  [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Mollie: A simple and scalable payment solution for modern businesses](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/bJ9ecz3yzZ9w70POHAtlIsq0j-2KK5roaefqczOvnoKvp-YnRsejWICMh7DYi5ltp0A1poYa0CyCE9u8Zv8FNGVl3_aP-zy3ZAVNRogyCrbPrFtdjMalQJjPyPfk94Pj8f-JjpFHfITRdc7BEs6cLq9jU5empDnsjuvb89CueIHBtiIx8SpsQQ_yOHNFIzhZ?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Mollie**

- Worth considering for UK and European customers.
- Supports various local payment methods.
- Transparent transaction-based pricing.
  
  [Mollie website](https://www.mollie.com/)

These recommendations reflect current UK comparisons and published pricing, although your actual fees depend on card type, location and sales volume. [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-payment-gateway/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/best-startup-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[startups.co.uk](https://startups.co.uk/payment-processing/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would choose

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online shop | Stripe |
| Using WooCommerce | Stripe + PayPal |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments + PayPal |
| Selling online and face-to-face | Square |
| Selling across Europe | Stripe or Mollie |
